records.text: Owens recalled that Kirk flew her to Wyoming, where she attended the release party for Kanye West’s ye album.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And you remember when you flew me out to Wyoming where he recorded that. ... I arrived at his album release party and I just kept replaying that track for you over and over and over again.

records.text: I had been trying for over a year to get his song Ghost Town for my podcast intro, best song on the Ye album.
